_note: Prototype assumptions for Karnataka. Edit freely; every number here is an estimate, not an official rate.
_vehicle_note: Trip cost = fixed (loading/waiting) + rate_per_km x one-way road km (rate already includes the empty return). Trips = ceil(quantity / capacity).
_market_fee_note: Karnataka APMC market fee (cess); it has been revised several times, so check the current notified rate.
_hamali_note: Loading/unloading/weighing charges per quintal (varies by APMC).
